name: Iron DTPA 11% Chelate
description: Standalone DTPA-chelated iron supplement, stable to higher pH than EDTA. At 11% Fe by mass, 0.1 g in 100 L adds ~0.11 ppm Fe (disclosed stoichiometry).
notes: DTPA keeps iron available up to ~pH 7.5 (vs EDTA's ~pH 6.5). Use to top up Fe in harder / higher-pH tanks.
